title: ophioglossum vulgatum var. engelmannii
intro: Ophioglossum vulgatum var. engelmannii, commonly known as the Engelmann's adderstool or Engelmann's grape fern, is a rare and endangered species of fern belonging to the genus Ophioglossum. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include immune system support, wound healing, and anti-bacterial activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Ophioglossum vulgatum var. engelmannii for medicinal purposes.
